Subject: Residency & export clearance — follow-up and next steps

Hi Elena — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and the actions we agreed: 

1) Compliance status you asked about: we will provide our up-to-date SOC 2 summary (attached) and a short note on GDPR/HIPAA applicability.
2) Vendor security questionnaire: I attached our standard SQ template; happy to accept FinApps' own form as well.
3) Data residency: Redwoods offers an EU region deployment (Frankfurt and Amsterdam). We can provision a customer-dedicated instance in EU to avoid cross-border primary storage.
4) Cross-border transfers: we support Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) and a DPA that includes SCCs.
5) Export control screening: we run entity-level OFAC/UK-BO/IL checks during onboarding; for ITAR/controlled-technology questions we'll need a short intake (see questions below).

Action items and owners: 
- Dylan (me): Send SOC 2 summary, vendor-sq template, and proposed DPA language by EOD 10/10.
- Elena/Procurement: Confirm whether you require a dedicated EU deployment or if multi-region with geo-fencing is sufficient by 10/15.
- Neha (Security): Provide clarifying notes on encryption, key management, and cross-border mechanism by 10/12.

Attachments: Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf, vendor-security-questionnaire-template.xlsx

If we can get those answers, I’ll put together a mutual action plan and timeline toward POC and procurement. Proposed tentative dates: compliance deep-dive 10/13 or 10/14 (30–45m). Which works best?

Thanks,
Dylan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Dylan — helpful recap. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- EU region: FinApps prefers EU-only hosting for production data. We need confirmation that backups and logs will remain in-region as well.
- Encryption/KM: Do you offer customer-managed keys (BYOK) in the EU offering? If not, what is the encryption-at-rest model?
- Vendor SQ: procurement will fill out the questionnaire but can you also provide a pointer to any existing attestations (ISO, SOC 2) in a centralized location?
- Export controls: We handle financial data across EU/UK and have ITAR-exempt status, but we need confirmation you do an OFAC screening for vendor entities and whether any parts of your software are subject to US export controls that would prevent cross-border access.

Procurement suggests we tentatively target the 10/14 slot for the compliance deep-dive (AM CET preferred). I’ll share the procurement POC details after they confirm availability.

Best,
Elena

Elena — appreciated. Quick answers before Neha provides a deeper write-up: 

- Backups/logs: We can limit backups and system logs to the EU region for a customer-dedicated deployment; standard shared-hosted backups may be multi-region unless you take a Dedicated option.
- BYOK: We support customer-managed keys for Dedicated and Private deployments; hosted EU customers can opt into BYOK via our KMS integrations (AWS KMS / Google KMS) — I’ll have Neha confirm exact flow.
- Attestations: SOC 2 summary is attached; we also have an internal portal with ISO and the full SOC 2 report under NDA (link below).
- OFAC/export: We perform entity-level screening on onboarding (OFAC/PEP/sanctions). For ITAR/controlled-technology, our product does not process defense technical data by default — if you have specific subsets that might be controlled we’ll need to review them.

Link to centralized attestations: https://redwood.example.com/security/soc2-summary (public summary; full report available under NDA)

I’ll schedule the 30-minute compliance deep-dive for 10/14 09:30 AM CET unless you confirm another time.

Thanks,
Dylan

Date: 2026-10-12T07:20:00Z
Subject: Internal: residency/export controls — technical notes for FinApps follow-up

Dylan / Monica — internal notes you can paste into the compliance deep-dive. Please keep this internal until we share the NDA-secured full SOC 2 report.

SOC 2 / attestations:
- Current status: SOC 2 Type II (security + availability) — most recent control period: 2025-07 to 2026-06. We publish a 2-page SOC 2 summary publicly and provide the full report under NDA. ISO 27001: in progress (cert expected Q1 2027).

Data residency / backups/logs:
- Dedicated EU deployment (customer VPC) keeps primary storage, snapshots, and system logs within EU regions (we currently support eu-central-1 and europe-west1).
- For hosted tenants (shared infra), logs and backups may transit or be stored in secondary regions unless a Dedicated contract includes geo-isolation clauses. We can add contractual clauses to ensure egress restrictions and log retention settings.

Encryption / KMS:
- At-rest encryption: AES-256. In EU Dedicated/Private deployments we support BYOK via customer-managed KMS keys (AWS KMS / GCP KMS / Azure Key Vault). For hosted tiers we offer platform-managed KMS but can enable BYOK for Enterprise customers.
- In-transit: TLS 1.2+ with modern ciphers.

Cross-border transfer mechanism:
- We rely on SCCs in customer DPAs for transfers from EU to US where applicable. We can support mitigation measures (data minimization, localized processing) and document subprocessor lists.

Export controls / OFAC / ITAR:
- Entity screening: we run sanctions/OFAC/PEP checks at onboarding.
- Software exportability: Our runtime includes ML building blocks that are not ITAR-controlled by default; however, customers with controlled datasets/applications should flag this.
- For ITAR or US-origin controlled content, we recommend Private or Dedicated deployment wholly inside EU; we will also engage Legal for a formal export-controls review if FinApps flags any controlled datasets.

Recommended next steps for the call:
- Confirm procurement’s requirement for EU-only production + backups/logs.
- Ask whether FinApps needs BYOK in-scope for production.
- If below-threshold for ITAR/controlled content, request a short intake form (one-pager) from FinApps describing data classes.
- Provide NDA link so we can share the full SOC 2 report and contract redlines.

NDA & documents: https://docusign.example.com/FinApps-SLA-123 (send NDA; attach full SOC 2 under NDA)

Neha Kapoor
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
